--LINKREFRESH -- 使用参数化变量 DECLARE @STOFCY VARCHAR(50) = '{0}', @X9HNUM VARCHAR(50) = '{1}',--X9HZUPK251200001 @LOC VARCHAR(30) = '#库位#';--A010101
-- 1. 使用窗口函数获取每个物料的库存记录并统计数量 WITH CTE_STK AS ( SELECT ITMREF_0, LOT_0, STA_0, SERNUM_0, LOC_0, STOCOU_0, STOFCY_0, QTYSTU_0, SLO_0, PALNUM_0, CTRNUM_0, STOFLD1_0, STOFLD2_0, -- 统计每个物料在指定库位的库存记录数 COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ITMREF_0) AS STK_COUNT, -- 为每个物料的库存记录排序，取第一条 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ITMREF_0 ORDER BY STOCOU_0) AS RN FROM STOCK WHERE STOFCY_0 = @STOFCY AND LOC_0 = @LOC AND STA_0 LIKE 'A%' ), -- 筛选每个物料的第一条库存记录，且该物料只有一个库存记录 SingleStock AS ( SELECT ITMREF_0, LOT_0, STA_0, SERNUM_0, LOC_0, STOCOU_0, STOFCY_0, QTYSTU_0, SLO_0, PALNUM_0, CTRNUM_0, STOFLD1_0, STOFLD2_0 FROM CTE_STK WHERE RN = 1 AND STK_COUNT = 1 -- 只取有且仅有一条库存记录的情况 ), -- 检查已存在的记录 ExistingRecords AS ( SELECT DISTINCT VCRNUM_0, VCRLIN_0 FROM XWSSCS WHERE VCRNUM_0 = @X9HNUM ) -- 2. 插入XWSSCS表 INSERT INTO XWSSCS ( MACHINEID_0, USERID_0, CUSERID_0, VCRTYP_0, PK_0, BATCHID_0, PKORI_0, CREDATIM_0, STAT_0, SUBDATIM_0, RPFLG_0, RPNUM_0, RPLIN_0, RPNOTE_0, RPDATE_0, RPDATIM_0, VCRNUM_0, VCRLIN_0, STOFCY_0, IPTDAT_0, VCRDES_0, PJT_0, TRSFAM_0, ITMREF_0, STU_0, QTYSTU_0, LOT_0, SLO_0, SERNUM_0, STOCOU_0, STA_0, STA_1, LOCTYP_0, LOCTYP_1, LOC_0, LOC_1, PALNUM_0, PALNUM_1, CTRNUM_0, CTRNUM_1, NOTE_0, NOTE_1, NOTE_2, NOTE_3, NOTE_4, BPRNUM_0, CREDATTIM_0, UPDDATTIM_0, AUUID_0, CREUSR_0, UPDUSR_0, WRH_0,STOFLD1_0,STOFLD2_0 ) SELECT '#LOGIN_ID#' AS MACHINEID_0, '#LOGIN_USER#' AS USERID_0, '#LOGIN_USER#' AS CUSERID_0, 29 AS VCRTYP_0, NEWID() AS PK_0, '' AS BATCHID_0, '' AS PKORI_0, GETDATE() AS CREDATIM_0, 1 AS STAT_0, '' AS SUBDATIM_0, 1 AS RPFLG_0, '' AS RPNUM_0, 0 AS RPLIN_0, '' AS RPNOTE_0, '' AS RPDATE_0, '' AS RPDATIM_0, T.X9HNUM_0 AS VCRNUM_0, T.X9DLIN_0 AS VCRLIN_0, H.STOFCY_0 AS STOFCY_0, GETDATE() AS IPTDAT_0, N'批量领料' AS VCRDES_0, '' AS PJT_0, 'MFGT' AS TRSFAM_0, T.ITMREF_0 AS ITMREF_0, T.PCU_0 AS STU_0, -- 计算领料数量：取可用库存和需求量的最小值 CASE WHEN S.QTYSTU_0 > T.QTYPCU_0 THEN T.QTYPCU_0 ELSE S.QTYSTU_0 END AS QTYSTU_0, S.LOT_0, S.SLO_0, S.SERNUM_0, S.STOCOU_0, S.STA_0 AS STA_0, S.STA_0 AS STA_1, '' AS LOCTYP_0, '' AS LOCTYP_1, S.LOC_0 AS LOC_0, H.X9HDESLOC_0 AS LOC_1, S.PALNUM_0 AS PALNUM_0, S.PALNUM_0 AS PALNUM_1, S.CTRNUM_0 AS CTRNUM_0, S.CTRNUM_0 AS CTRNUM_1, '' AS NOTE_0, '' AS NOTE_1, '' AS NOTE_2, '' AS NOTE_3, '' AS NOTE_4, '' AS BPRNUM_0, GETDATE() AS CREDATTIM_0, '' AS UPDDATTIM_0, NEWID() AS AUUID_0, 'TTLNK' AS CREUSR_0, '' AS UPDUSR_0, ( SELECT TOP 1 WRH_0 FROM STOLOC WHERE LOC_0 = S.LOC_0 AND STOFCY_0 = S.STOFCY_0 ) AS WRH_0, S.STOFLD1_0, S.STOFLD2_0 FROM XCN09SGD T INNER JOIN XCN09SGH H ON T.X9HNUM_0 = H.X9HNUM_0 INNER JOIN SingleStock S -- 改为INNER JOIN，确保只有单个库存记录的物料才被处理 ON T.ITMREF_0 = S.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ExistingRecords XWS ON T.X9HNUM_0 = XWS.VCRNUM_0 AND T.X9DLIN_0 = XWS.VCRLIN_0 WHERE T.X9HNUM_0 = @X9HNUM AND XWS.VCRNUM_0 IS NULL -- 排除已存在的记录 ORDER BY T.X9DLIN_0; -- 按行号排序，保持插入顺序
